en.title: Inde Navarrette on SNL Hosting, X-Men Training, and a Pamela Anderson Encounter
en.summary: Fresh off a whirlwind weekend attending major industry events, rising star Inde Navarrette is gearing up for a massive Halloween hosting gig on Saturday Night Live. The actress also shared insights into her preparation for potential X-Men roles and a memorable meeting with a pop culture icon.
en.body:
The past few weeks have been a whirlwind for **Inde Navarrette**, a testament to her rapidly ascending career. Fresh from appearing at the Academy Museum Gala and being honored as one of Variety’s 10 Actors to Watch at the Newport Beach Film Festival, the actress is also set to take on a monumental hosting gig. Navarrette will host the upcoming Halloween episode of **Saturday Night Live**, a significant milestone that underscores her growing prominence in Hollywood. This announcement alone has fans buzzing about her comedic timing and stage presence.

Beyond the iconic Studio 8H stage, Navarrette has been diving deep into the world of superheroics, engaging in rigorous stunt training for potential **X-Men** roles. While details remain scarce, her dedication to mastering physical performance hints at an exciting future within the genre. The prospect of her embodying a beloved mutant, perhaps even a fan-favorite like Rogue given her past roles, has ignited considerable speculation among comic book enthusiasts. Adding to the star-studded narrative of her recent experiences, Navarrette also shared a delightful anecdote about a chance encounter with the legendary **Pamela Anderson**, a meeting that clearly left a lasting impression.

## From Fan Favorite to Future Icon

Navarrette’s journey to this point has been marked by memorable performances that have resonated with audiences. Her roles as Estela De La Cruz in the impactful **13 Reasons Why** and Sarah Cushing in the CW’s **Superman & Lois** have showcased her range and ability to connect with complex characters. More recently, her performance in the series **Obsession** has been widely praised for its emotional depth and raw vulnerability, further cementing her status as a formidable talent. This blend of dramatic gravitas and readiness for genre spectacle positions her as a unique and compelling figure in contemporary entertainment.

## What's Next on the Horizon

The immediate future for **Inde Navarrette** is undeniably bright. With her **Saturday Night Live** hosting debut on the horizon and ongoing preparations for potential blockbuster roles, fans have plenty to anticipate. Her growing presence across different facets of the entertainment industry suggests that this is just the beginning of a remarkable career, and audiences will be eagerly watching her next move, whether it’s on a sketch comedy stage or a superhero film set.

She has also been involved in X-Men stunt training and had a notable meeting with Pamela Anderson.
